texts: On day 92 of Year 1, the first hard frost came.
The harbor was white with rime in the morning.
The cold wind blew off the sea from dusk until dawn.
Every lantern on the Cliff Path held salt-bloom in its mire-essence.
Every lantern on the Cliff Path stayed lit from dusk until dawn.

q1_issues.issue: (Ordinal sk_frost_1 1 frost) fills the scale slot with the entity's own class; the instruction licenses only the associated event (here come) or an explicit '-est' dimension in that slot.

q2_gaps: cross-sentence definite anaphora to a referent that exists only inside a quantified rule: 'The mire-essence' (S5) refers back to the per-lantern Skolem term (sk_mire_essence $x) minted in S4's universal rule, and the instruction set gives no way for a later sentence to corefer with a rule-internal referent
review.notes: S5's fresh sk_mire_essence_1 witness is the only licensed fallback but it severs the link to S4's per-lantern mire-essence, so 'the mire-essence burned' floats free of the lanterns. The rest follows the instruction set closely: copular time-modifier reification plus flat atom (S2), interval Start/End on dusk/dawn, the 'stayed lit' continuation copular with Still, and the two universal rules carrying the 'on the Cliff Path' restriction as a premise conjunct.

issues.reason: Comparatives & degree fixes Ordinal's third slot to an ordering — 'the associated event, or an explicit -est dimension' ('Priya was the first to respond' -> (Ordinal priya 1 respond) beside the reified respond event) — and this clause supplies that event (come), so the entity's own class 'frost' is not a licensed filler and the stored atom would miss the query form the instruction set prescribes.

gaps_confirmed: Cross-sentence definite anaphora into a rule-internal referent: S5's 'The mire-essence' points at the per-lantern Skolem term (sk_mire_essence $x) minted inside S4's universal, and nothing in the instruction set lets a later sentence corefer with a referent that exists only under a rule binding.
new_gaps: A day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ('day 92 of Year 1'): the Time term inventory is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, so (Day 92) borrows the day-of-month slot — the granularity is misrecorded, and with no Month the seeded year/month/day ordering rules cannot order two such dates against each other.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is (Ordinal sk_frost_1 1 come) — the lemma of the clause's own reified event in the scale slot, exactly as 'the first to respond' yields (Ordinal priya 1 respond).
adjudication.notes: The rest holds up under the instruction set: S2's time-modified copular reifies the state plus the flat (Past (Member sk_harbor_1 white)) and hangs 'with rime' on the state witness as an adjective-PP complement, 'came' / 'blew' take Patient as non-volitional natural processes, dusk/dawn ride Start/End, and both universals carry 'on the Cliff Path' as an entity-attached (On $x cliff_path) premise conjunct with the mandatory QuantifierPhrase companion. S6's 'stayed lit' follows the continuation-copular shape — reified state + Still + flat atom + tense — distributed over the rule.
